# Nafiz Anam

> Technology & Product Partner for growth-stage businesses and funded founders. Diagnoses the real problem behind a technical bottleneck, decides the right direction, and leads or executes the fix — spanning custom software development, SaaS product engineering, AI automation, technical consulting/architecture, cloud infrastructure/DevOps, and engineering leadership. Based in Khulna, Bangladesh; works with clients worldwide. Founder of Agilo IT; also behind Syrona IT / Servero.io (server-side Google Tag Manager hosting for ecommerce brands).
